Method of Attack: formjacking, payment card scraping, web-based skimming by injecting malicious scripts on payment pages to steal payment card data
Impacted Systems: websites including Ticketmaster, British Airways, Feedify, Newegg, Magento-based webshops
Attack Vector: compromised websites with injected malicious scripts on checkout/payment pages
Indicators of Compromise: domains and scripts associated with Magecart campaigns, over 1000 domains tracked, some sinkholed domains, Magecart IoCs collected by Kevin Beaumont
